claim_scope: Reusable development and candidate-screening baseline; the source run is one measured dense run and is not itself final three-run repeatability or task-accuracy acceptance.

reuse_policy.default: Reuse without rerunning dense when all material baseline fields match.
reuse_policy.candidate_only_change: A candidate-only algorithm, selector, cache, or operator change does not invalidate this baseline when DRRQR-disabled dispatch and the common dense path are proven unchanged.
must_rebaseline_if: container image, driver, firmware, CANN, vLLM, or vLLM-Ascend execution identity changes
a code or configuration change can affect the DRRQR-disabled dense path
device mapping, tensor parallelism, power or clock mode, or relevant topology changes
workload tokens, requests, concurrency, warmup, scheduling, graph mode, or benchmark client changes
artifact integrity or environment comparability cannot be proved
reuse_policy.drift_check: Before each comparison, compare the current manifest to this contract. Rebaseline only on a listed material mismatch; do not rerun dense merely because a new candidate is tested.

accuracy_baseline.required_protocol: Current same-stack dense, thinking disabled, max_tokens=2048, normal EOS, LongBench-v2 and GSM8K.
accuracy_baseline.historical_claim: Context only; different configuration and therefore not the frozen final accuracy baseline.
accuracy_baseline.reuse_after_creation: Once the current same-stack accuracy baseline and hashes are recorded, reuse it under the same material-change rules instead of rerunning it for every candidate.
